content:
1. Topic Title: Introduction to Data Analysis
   Project: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on a public dataset like Airbnb listings or IMDb movies

  2. Topic Title: SQL Fundamentals
   Project: Query a database and manipulate data using SQL by completing tasks in an online SQL tutorial like SQLBolt

  3. Topic Title: Data Visualization Basics
   Project: Create bar graphs, scatter plots, and histograms for the EDA dataset to visualize findings

  4. Topic Title: Intermediate SQL (joins, aggregations, subqueries)
   Project: Design a multi-table query to analyze relationships between datasets in an online practice platform like HackerRank

  5. Topic Title: Python for Data Analysis
   Project: Implement data manipulation tasks using Python libraries such as pandas and NumPy on the EDA dataset

  6. Topic Title: Machine Learning Foundations
   Project: Build a basic machine learning model (like linear regression) on the EDA dataset to make predictions

  7. Topic Title: Feature Engineering
   Project: Develop new features from existing ones in the EDA dataset that could improve predictive power of the machine learning model

  8. Topic Title: Model Evaluation and Optimization
   Project: Split the EDA dataset into training and testing sets, evaluate the model's performance, and optimize it by tuning hyperparameters
